book.name: Maak
book.title: Pwoo ɗeret nKaa Jesu Kristi Ɗe Maak

content: Sǝmpwoo nKaa MeeNennaa Bong Mo

Jesu ɗoom sat pwoo ngurum mo shi sǝmpwoo mo nǝnee, <<Gyet mee ngulu wur kop anab mo mbong wur, ɓe wur neer nǝ shi kok, wur ɓwan mee tuun mɓe ɗwat làa tǝng anab nǝ, kǝzak, wur ɗyik mee ɗengpee mɓe naa anab nǝ. Ɗangɓe wur yit mar nǝ nsar mee kǝ nennaa mar mo, mbǝkǝ mo naa bong nǝ ɗe nwur. Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓe wur yool dǝm mmee yil.
Kaaɗe tar nung làa anab nǝ wul, ɓe wur lep mee kǝrem nwur dǝm pee nennaa maar anab nǝ mo ɗe, mbǝkǝ kǝrem lap pak làa anab nǝ dǝm kǝ nǝ ɗe nwur.
Ɗangɓe nennaa maar anab nǝ mo yaa kǝrem ni, mo nǝram wur, ɓe mo ceen wur baa shi sar ɗe nfii.
Ngulu nǝ wur waa baa lep mee kǝrem shiin dǝm pee mo ɗe zak. Ɓe mo nas wur nkáa, kǝ mo shínjeel nkǝrem mǝnǝ zak.
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓe ngulu nǝ wu waa baa lep mee kǝrem dǝm pee nennaa mar nǝ mo zak, ɓe mo yaa kǝrem mǝnǝ tu, kǝ moo naa ncìn mpak kǝrem nǝ mo aasǝ zak, har mo nǝram pak mo, kǝ mo twe pak mo.

Ngulu nǝ wur ɗee ɗe kǝ memee mǝndong, ɗe mǝnǝ a làa wur ɗewur nwal nlàa nǝ zam. Ɓe wur lep làa nǝ dǝm pee nennaa bong nǝ mo ɗe, aɓwoon kǝ kǝrem nǝ mo jir. Ngulu nǝ wur pan nǝnee, <Nentap maar nǝ mon naa ɗeɗes kǝ làa fin.>
Ɗangɓe nennaa maar nǝ mo sat nshak nǝnee, <wu naa a làa ɗe mǝnǝn nyool ghǝr kop puun nǝ nɗesi, wu jì mmun, kǝ mǝ tu wur, mbǝkǝ kop nǝ ɗee ɗe a munu.>
Ɗangɓe mo yaa làa nǝ tu, ɓe mo vwet kúm nǝ shin ciir mɓwoon kok maar nǝ.
Wur pan nǝ, ngumaar nǝ wur ncìn a me kǝ nennaa maar ɗesǝ nǝ mo ye? Wun njì twe nennaa mar ɗesǝ nǝ mo, mbǝkǝ wur le mee nennaa mar ɗecì mo ɗi.
Baa wuu cam tang pwoo ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan sǝ kas me? Ɗe nǝ sat nǝnee, <<nGhǝk ɗe nen ɗyiklu mo cii nǝ, <<Ɓe a nǝ ɗee a ɗeɗes nɗǝǝn kwang lu nǝ.
Ɗesǝ nǝ a ɗak ɗe Daa wur kǝ ten cìn; <<Nǝ a mbii aapwoo pee mun ɗi!> >>

Nennan mǝ nen Yahudi mo yappee mɓe yaa Jesu, mbǝɗe mo man nǝ, wur sat sǝmpwoo ɗesǝ nǝ a nkaa mo, ɗangɓǝ baa mo mak yaa wur kas, mbǝɗe mo kǝǝr ɗuu gurum nǝ mo. Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe mo yool yit wur ɗe, ɓe mo dǝm ntul.
Gurum Mo Cìn TalnKaa Kwatwap nSiza
Ɗangɓe nen Farisi mo kǝ nen nHerot mo lep pak nen fur mo shindǝm pee Jesu ɗe, mbǝkǝ mo kat mee mbii ɗe mon nyaa wur ɗi nɗǝǝn pwoo ɗewur sat mo.

Kaaɗe mo jì, ɓe mo sat nJesu nǝnee, <<Ngukám, mu man nǝ, gha a nguzeen, baa waa kǝ kak mee gurum kas, ɗang baa waa kǝ shangyit mmee gurum kas zak, ɗangɓǝ gha aa kám ar Naan ngurum mo azeen-nzeen. Kyet nǝn ndere kǝ mu kwatwap Siza, mishkoom ɗeɗes mu nen Rom mo aa, koo mu nook kwat nǝ yi?>>
Ɗangɓe mbǝɗe Jesu man pan ɗebish mǝ pǝtuup fur mo, ɓe wur lap mmo nǝnee, <<A me le ɗangɓe wuu kam nghan yi? Wu jì kǝ mee shool zinariya nǝ nghan naa.>>
Ɓe mo jì kǝ memee nwur. Ɓe Jesu tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<A mǝ riin mukáa, kǝ sǝm mu we, a rǝran nkaa shool nǝ yi?>> Mo lap nǝnee, <<A mǝ Siza mishkoom nRom.>>
Jesu sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wu shin nSiza mbii ɗe mo a mǝ Siza, kǝ wu shin Naan mbii ɗe mo a mǝ Naan zak.>> Nǝ aapwoo mmo zam mɓe mbii ɗewur sat nǝ.
Talpwoo nKaa Yool A Peemúut
Pak nen Saddusi mo, nen ɗe moo sat nǝ, baa mee yool a peemúut ɗe kas, mo jì pee Jesu ɗe, ɓe mo tal pǝ wur nǝnee,

<<Ngukám, Mosis kǝ ran mmun nǝ, katɗang mee gurum muut seet yit mat wur ɗi, ɗe baa war làa-làa nwur kas, ɓe nnǝ mee ɗyemnǝǝn wur lap matkaa nǝ, mbǝkǝ wur làa-làa mo ɗe nɗyemnǝǝn fin ɗe wu kǝ ten muut nǝ.
Gyet mee ɗyemnǝǝnshak mo ɗe pwovǝl. Gwar ɗenshee nǝ wur lapmat, ɓe wur muut nɗin nlàa mee làa.
Ɓe ɗyemnǝǝn fin ɗevǝl nǝ wur lap matkaa nǝ, ɓe baa wur làa mee làa kas, ɗang wur jì muut. Gwar ɗekun nǝ wur waa lap matkaa nǝ war zak.
Ɗang mo pwovǝl, mo lapmat nǝ war, ɓǝ mo jì murǝp jir, ɓe baa memee yit mee làa ɗee ɗe kas. Kyes nǝ, ɓe mat nǝ war yool muut aɓwoon kǝ mo nǝ jir zak.
To, katɗang parpuus yool a peemúut, ɓe war kǝ nɗee a mat we nɗǝǝn mo pwovǝl sǝ ye? Mɓeɗi mo jir, mo kǝ lap war mmat.>>
Jesu sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wun wuu ɗel ɗikǝ, mbǝɗe baa wu man mbii ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Naan kas, kǝ baa wu man ɗeɗes Naan kas zak.
Mɓeɗi parpuus ɗe nen nǝ mon nyool a peemúut, ɓe mon nɗee a kaa nenlep Naan ɗe aɗeng mo sǝ. Baa mee lapmat, koo dǝmɗyik ɗe kas.

Pwoo nkaa yool a peemúut mǝ nen ɗe mo kǝ ten murǝp mo, ɓe baa wuu kam tang pwoo ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nǝ nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal Mosis kas aa? Mbii ɗe Naan sat nwur nɗǝǝn làa lǝǝt ɗe nǝ lapwus sí nǝ, <Wen a Naan kǝ Abraham, kǝ Naan Aizik, kǝ Naan kǝ Jekop.>
Baa wur a Naan mu nenmuut mo kas, amma a mǝ nen ɗe mmeen mo. (Ɗesǝ nǝ kám nǝ koo ɗe mo kǝ ten murap ɓe mo ɗe kǝ seen pee Naan.) Wun wu ɗel ɗikǝ bish-bish hakyeng!>>
Wàar Ɗǝɗes Met Jir

Mee gwar mɓut nenkám Wàar Mosis mo, wur jì kǝlǝng mo nkaa ɓeetshik nǝ, ɓe wur kǝlǝng Jesu tap lappwoo nǝ nen Saddusi mo rǝret. Ɓe wur tal pǝ Jesu nǝnee, <<A Wàar ɗeɗang a ɗeɗes met jir nɗǝǝn Wàar nǝ mo yi?>>
Jesu lap nwur nǝnee, <<A Wàar ɗeɗes met nǝ nɗesi, <Wun nen Isreil mo, wur kǝleng. Daa Naan fun, a wur a Daa mǝndong ɓejee.
A wal nDaa Naan fwaa shi pǝtuup fwaa jir, shi seen fwaa jir, kǝ shi pan fwaa jir, kǝ shiɓal fwaa jir.>
Ɗe vǝl nǝ a kaa mǝnǝ sǝ zak nǝnee, <A wal ngǝnang fwaa kaa sak fwaa sǝ.> Baa mee Wàar ɗe waa ɗes met ɗe vǝl sǝ mo kas.>>
Ngukám Wàar Mosis nǝ wur sat nJesu nǝnee, <<Azeen Ngukám, a sat a rǝret. Daa Naan wur a mǝndong ɓejee ɗak, baa memee ɗe kas, see a wur mbǝshin.

Kǝ nǝ a tǝng kǝ gurum nwal nwur shi pǝtuup fin jir, kǝ shi pan fin jir, kǝ shiɓal fin jir, kǝ gurum nwal ngǝnǝǝn fin kaa shin fin sǝ zak. Wàar ɗe vǝl sǝ mo ret met nlong ɗe gurum moo shin mbe wus mbiizuum, kǝ koor mbiizuum ɗe gurum moo shin mon nNaan jir.>>
Kaaɗe Jesu kǝlǝng gwar nǝ tap lappwoo nǝ rǝret, ɓe wur sat ngwar nǝ nǝnee, <<Baa waa jong kǝ mulki Naan kas.>> Aɓwoon ɗesǝ ɓe baa mee gurum mak katɓal mputuup mɓe tal mee pwoo ɗe pǝ Jesu zak kas.
Kristi Wur A Làa Kǝ Weyii?
Kaaɗe Jesu nkaa kam-kam ngurum mo nɗǝǝn Lu Naan ɗǝɗes, ɓe wur tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<A me le ɗangɓe nenkám Wàar Mosis moo sat nǝ, <Kristi wur a làa Devit ye?>
Mɓeɗi Riin Naan nǝ le kǝ Devit shikáa fin wu sat nǝnee,

content.text: Har parɗi wen le shaarlek fwaa mo

content: Devit pet Kristi a Daa fin, ɓe cirang ɗang Kristi wu waa ciir ɗee a Làa Devit zak ye?>> Ɗuu gurum nǝ mo kǝlǝng wur shi retnyit.
Tap Kǝ Kam NǝKam Waar Mosis

nƊǝǝn kám Jesu, ɓe wur sat ngurum nǝ mo nǝnee, <<Wu tap kǝ kam nenkám Wàar Mosis mo. Mo a nen ɗe moo jwal nlǝr ɗeshwal-shwal mo, kǝ moo mwaan mbǝkǝ gurum mo naa mo ɗi. Moo rǝɓet kǝ gurum mo tok kǝ mo nɗǝǝn lutuk.
Kǝ moo rǝɓet peetong mǝ nennan-nan mo nɗǝǝn lu Naan mo, kǝ moo rǝɓet peetong ɗeret met jir mo a pee serǝɓet mo.

A moo yak matkaa mo kǝ lee fur mo, kǝ moo ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) ɗeshwal-shwal mo shi nyang zak, mbǝkǝ gurum mo kwoop mo ɗi. Mɓee mbii ɗebish ɗe moo cìn ɗesǝ mo, ɓe Naan wur ncin kwat ɗeshwal mo ɗes hakyeng.>>
Mee Matkaa Ɓwet mBiizuum
Kaaɗe Jesu tong a kyeen, kus kǝ pee ɓwet shool mbiizuum mǝ Lu Naan ɗeɗes nǝ, ɓe wur naa kaaɗi gurum moo ɓwet shool mbiizuum fur mo ɗe nɗǝǝn nǝ. Pak nenlong mo ɗes mo ɓwet shool ɗes nɗǝǝn nǝ.
Ɓe mee matkaa ɗe war a matjeel waa jì ɓwet rep anini mo vǝl ɗe nɗǝǝn nǝ zak.
Jesu pǝrep jeplep wur nǝ mo jì ashak, ɓe wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Azeen kǝn sat nwun, mbii ɗe matkaa ɗejeel ɗesǝ waa ɓwet nɗǝǝn kwati mǝ ɓwet mbiizuum nǝ, nǝ met mǝ koor gurum nǝ mo jir.
Mɓeɗi nen ɗesǝ mo jir, mo ɓwet mbiizuum nǝ a mɓut nɗes mǝ long ɗe mo kǝni, ɗangɓǝ war nɗǝǝn jeel war, ɓe war sǝhǝt ɓwet a kyes kǝ mbii ɗe war kǝ nǝ.>>
